questions.text: Which bird is famously nocturnal and hoots in the night?
questions.explanation: Many owl species hunt at night and call with hoots.

questions.text: What do bees make that is often spread on toast?
How many legs does an adult insect have?
questions.explanation: Insects have three pairs of legs.

questions.text: Which is the largest living bird?
questions.explanation: Ostriches can stand around 2.5 metres tall.

questions.text: Which sea creature has eight arms?
What is the largest species of whale?
questions.explanation: Blue whales are the largest known animals.

questions.text: Which insect develops from a caterpillar through a chrysalis stage?
Which bird of prey is the national bird of the United States?
questions.explanation: The bald eagle appears on the Great Seal.

questions.text: What is the traditional collective noun for a group of crows?
questions.explanation: 'A murder of crows' is the classic term.

questions.text: Which of these sea animals is a mammal?
questions.explanation: Dolphins breathe air and nurse their young.

questions.text: Which seabird migrates from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back each year?
questions.explanation: The Arctic tern enjoys long polar summers at both ends of its journey.

questions.text: Which North Atlantic sea is the breeding ground of the European eel?
questions.explanation: European eels travel to the Sargasso Sea to spawn.

questions.text: What is the largest species of shark and fish?
questions.explanation: The whale shark is a harmless filter feeder.

questions.text: Which bird has the largest wingspan of any living bird, up to about 3.5 metres?
questions.explanation: The wandering albatross glides over the Southern Ocean.

questions.text: In emperor penguins, which parent incubates the single egg on its feet through the Antarctic winter?
answers: Neither; the egg is left in a stone nest
questions.explanation: Males balance the egg on their feet while the females feed at sea.

spares.text: Which sea creature has a hard shell, pincers and walks sideways?
spares.explanation: Crabs move sideways on their jointed legs.

spares.text: Which large-billed bird from tropical Central and South America is famous for its colourful beak?
spares.explanation: Toucans use their long bills to reach fruit.

spares.text: Butterflies and moths belong to which insect order?
Architeuthis is the scientific name of which deep-sea animal?
spares.explanation: Giant squid can grow to over ten metres.
